## Product Owner outcome

Describe the problem solved and the owner-visible result.

## What changed

Summarize the implementation and any material decisions or trade-offs.

## Evidence

List tests and checks run. Include screenshots for meaningful UI changes.

## Limitations

Record known limitations, compatibility concerns, or follow-up work.

## Checklist

- [ ] I kept this pull request focused on one coherent outcome.
- [ ] I added or updated relevant tests.
- [ ] I ran the full test command, or explained what I could not run.
- [ ] I ran `git diff --check`.
- [ ] I updated the README, product specification, or technical design when their claims changed.
- [ ] I removed credentials, private data, generated build products, and unrelated changes.
- [ ] I reviewed and understand any AI-assisted contribution included here.
